boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed above the issuer's block on every copy. A corrected form replaces one furnished earlier; its figures are the ones to use, never counted beside the earlier form's.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed on Copy A (the issuer's filing copy) and the state copy; the recipient's Copy B does not print it.

boxes.label: Account number
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. An account or other unique number the issuer assigned; identification only, never a figure.

boxes.label: CUSIP number
boxes.notes: Recipient instruction: 'Shows the CUSIP (Committee on Uniform Security Identification Procedures) number or other applicable identifying number, if applicable to the digital assets disposed.' Identification only.

document.notes: NEW for tax year 2025. THE BASIS RULE IS THE TRAP: the form's own Instructions for Recipient say of box 1g — 'If box 1g is blank, you will need to determine your basis based on your own books and records. If box 1g has any entry, including zero, the information within that box has been reported to the IRS as basis.' So BLANK means UNKNOWN and must never be read as zero; and a printed 0 is a real assertion of zero basis, not a missing value. Box 9 (noncovered) says boxes 1d, 1g, 1h, 1i, 2 and 6 may all be blank. Box 11c is NOT a component of box 1f — box 1f's own instruction says it 'does not include the gross proceeds from the first sale of any specified NFTs you created or minted, which are reported in box 11c', so the two are disjoint and 11c is additional, not inside.

extraction.note: Azure ships no prebuilt-tax model for this form, so it reached the generic reader — which emits no field bearing these box names, so every cited route out of this document was dead while looking implemented (spec 075 US1/W42). Read by the declared custom model over the boxes this document declares. The `applicable checkbox on form 8949` is read as a box of its own because it addresses every row beneath it.

custom.reads: a Form 1099-DA, Digital Asset Proceeds From Broker Transactions, and its per-transaction detail. The checkbox printed at the head of the form applies to every row beneath it, so read it as a box of its own.
